// Verilog2Chisel Build Configuration
val chiselVersion = "6.7.0"
val scalaVersionFromChisel = "2.13.16"

lazy val root = (project in file("."))
  .settings(
    name := "chisel_extra_bench",
    organization := "edu.berkeley.cs",
    version := "1.0",
    scalaVersion := scalaVersionFromChisel,
    
    scalacOptions ++= Seq(
      "-deprecation",
      "-unchecked",
      "-Ymacro-annotations"
    ),
    
    libraryDependencies ++= Seq(
      "org.chipsalliance" %% "chisel" % chiselVersion,
    ),
    
    addCompilerPlugin("org.chipsalliance" % "chisel-plugin" % chiselVersion cross CrossVersion.full),
    
    // Source directories
    Compile / scalaSource := baseDirectory.value,
    Compile / unmanagedSourceDirectories += baseDirectory.value / ".." / ".." / "chiselfv" / "src" / "main" / "scala",
    
    resolvers ++= Resolver.sonatypeOssRepos("snapshots") ++ 
                  Resolver.sonatypeOssRepos("releases") ++ 
                  Seq(Resolver.mavenLocal)
  )

# Verilog2Chisel Makefile
# Compiles Chisel code to Verilog

BUILD_DIR ?= generated

.PHONY: all
all: verilog

.PHONY: verilog
verilog:
	@echo "Compiling Chisel to Verilog..."
	@mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)
	sbt "runMain llmverify.VerilogGenerator --target-dir $(BUILD_DIR)"

.PHONY: clean
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR)
	rm -rf target project/target project/project

.PHONY: clean-all
clean-all: clean
	rm -rf *.scala

.PHONY: help
help:
	@echo "Verilog2Chisel Makefile"
	@echo "  make verilog  - Compile Chisel to Verilog"
	@echo "  make clean    - Clean build artifacts"
	@echo "  make help     - Show this help message"
